resources.string: Widget needs two taps to start or stop (prevents accidental presses)
Tap the red button to start recording. Video is stamped with the date, time and location, and uploaded to your Google Drive every few seconds.

Open WitnessCam and reconnect your cloud account so recordings can upload.
Shorter chunks reach the cloud sooner. At most this much footage is at risk if the phone is taken.

Also record the front camera (to separate files) if the phone supports it

⚠ SMS permission not allowed. Texts can\'t be sent.

Android blocked the SMS permission. This is normal on Android 13 and newer for apps installed from a downloaded file instead of the Play Store.

1. Tap Open app settings.
2. Tap the ⋮ menu (top right) and choose "Allow restricted settings". Confirm with your PIN or fingerprint. If that option isn't there, skip this step.
3. Tap Permissions → SMS → Allow.
4. Come back to WitnessCam. This screen will show the SMS permission is allowed.

Recording both cameras at once failed on this phone, so WitnessCam has switched to the rear camera only. You can turn the front camera back on in Settings.
Allow fingerprint or face instead of the PIN
Convenient, but someone can hold the phone to your face or press your finger to it without your cooperation; nobody can do that with a PIN only you know. The PIN always works as a fallback.
Set a PIN first. It stays as the fallback.
No fingerprint or face is set up on this phone (Android Settings → Security).

✓ Battery optimisation is off for WitnessCam, so uploads can run in the background.
Battery optimisation may pause uploads when the app isn\'t open. Tap the button above and choose Allow.

On Honor/Huawei phones also open Android Settings → Battery → App launch (or Apps → WitnessCam → Battery) → turn off \"Manage automatically\" and turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
